purpose: Review a system-light color variant alongside the retained dark candidate. Values are derived for legibility and are not sampled source colors.

source_constraints.derivation: Retain Atmospheric semantic roles and component geometry. Derive a pale cool neutral field, opaque-looking light surfaces, and dark role colors; then adjust each foreground role to meet the documented WCAG contrast checks. No source-pixel transcription is claimed.

system_mode_mapping.selection_effect: colors only; preserve theme identity, layout, typography, weather facts, chronology, provenance, navigation, persistence, and refresh behavior

contrast_contract.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance for sRGB hex colors; alpha-composite surface/elevatedSurface over canvas, atmosphereTop, and atmosphereBottom before measuring. Ratios round only for display; pass/fail uses full precision.

light.surface_behavior: Keep current surface opacity, radius, border, spacing, type, and effects policy; color values alone vary by system mode.

open_decisions: D31 remains open: no selection between consistent dark-teal option A and shared blue/scenic option B. This light proposal selects neither scene direction.
D28 remains open; the D29 weather-mark matrix was owner-approved as presented on 2026-09-24. This does not approve the TP.1D packet or close TP.1D/TP.1; TP.2 eligibility remains gated.
